preservedLimitations: GitHub pinned source links were validated by file identity/retrieval; this does not validate every historical table assertion against current stable releases.

The historical local RNMapbox checkout lacks the 10.3.7 Git object; pinned raw sources were retrieved successfully instead. Initial local-object failures and web cache misses were retrieval limitations, not broken-link conclusions.
No source-line anchors appear in the reviewed source links; links identify exact files rather than validating line-number claims.

Examples use workspace-built current declaration paths for practical usage checking; this review did not assemble all snippets into applications or independently repeat packed-consumer/runtime suites.
Parent-owned generated coverage/status and selection decision were excluded from mutation. Their current evidence was used only to qualify documentation status.
This review completes bounded editorial work and does not mark S50 or final implementation conformance complete.

remainingFactualInvestigations.investigation: Revalidate the historical RNMapbox 10.3.3 / react-map-gl 8.1.0-alpha.2 comparisons against pinned RNMapbox 10.3.7 / react-map-gl 8.1.3: container/host fields, camera limits and gestures, camera/event payloads, command timing, projection/bounds, readiness and controlled-camera interception. Replace individual source citations only after checking the corresponding current implementation.
remainingFactualInvestigations.requiredEvidence: Current pinned wrapper source/declarations and checked equivalent upstream examples; owning camera/event stages provide independent six-environment runtime evidence.

remainingFactualInvestigations.investigation: Revalidate source kinds/options, layer field and ordering support, immutable option updates, source ownership, property removal/reset, query result and coordinate shapes, cluster signatures, image conversion and feature-state behavior against current stable wrappers/renderers. Field inventory or matching names alone does not establish behavior.
remainingFactualInvestigations.requiredEvidence: Pinned current source links per material comparison; source/layer/query/feature-state owning-stage renderer scenarios, including reset and frame observations.

remainingFactualInvestigations.investigation: Revalidate live-view/bitmap annotation child behavior, dragging, offsets/anchors, popup attachment/dismissal, ornaments, controls and registry APIs. MapLibre 11.5.0 historical pin already matches the implementation wrapper, but its platform/runtime comparisons still need the owning-stage evidence.
remainingFactualInvestigations.requiredEvidence: Current source and checked equivalent examples; real native child touches, dragging and popup teardown scenarios rather than callback invocation.

remainingFactualInvestigations.investigation: Revalidate offline pack identity/options/download progress, capture/static image options and contents, location permission/tracking/display, custom layers, and renderer-specific facilities against pinned current versions. Extension signatures remain proposals; wrapper omissions do not prove SDK limitations.
remainingFactualInvestigations.requiredEvidence: Current pinned source and extension declarations; each extension owning stage supplies success, operational failure, unsupported outcomes and cleanup evidence.
